findings.title: taskspec id derivation collides across projects that share a final dash segment
findings.detail: lifecycle.plan() derives spec ids as f"TS-{project_id.split('-')[-1]}-{i:02d}". Project CNV-R9-RESIDUAL-CLOSURE therefore derived TS-CLOSURE-01.., the SAME ids the R8 project CNV-R8-SKILL-SLIM-EIA-CLOSURE had already created, so admit_workorders() died with sqlite3.IntegrityError: UNIQUE constraint failed: taskspecs.taskspec_id (spine.py:277) BEFORE any WorkOrder existed.
findings.consequence: the project stays in PLAN_READY with zero taskspecs and cannot ever admit workorders under its own id, because every retry re-derives the same colliding ids; the only recovery is a different project id
findings.disclosure: project CNV-R9-RESIDUAL-CLOSURE remains in the spine at PLAN_READY, 0 taskspecs, 0 workorders, and is left in place (no SQL, no state-column writes). It is disclosed here and joins the pre-existing PLAN_READY residue class recorded as BLK-R7-08 (CNV-R6R7-ARCHIVE-REPAIR-R6ARC, CNV-R6R7-ARCHIVE-REPAIR-R7, CNV-R6R7-EVIDENCE-ARCHIVE-REPAIR-20261015).
findings.not_claimed: the same mechanism is NOT established as the cause of those three pre-existing residues - their final segments differ from one another, so their stranding has a different or additional cause which this round did not measure

remediation_options.change: admit under a project id whose final dash segment is globally unique (CNV-R9-FARCLOSURE)
remediation_options.authority: within HGK admission, no owner act needed

remediation_options.change: make the derivation collision-proof in the control plane, e.g. namespace the spec id by the full project id or a project hash
remediation_options.friction: low - one expression in lifecycle.plan(); needs an HGK control-plane WorkOrder

remediation_options.change: recover or explicitly retire the stranded PLAN_READY projects via typed APIs if the lifecycle offers them; otherwise record them as accepted residue

claim_ceiling: LOCAL / candidate-only; a defect report, not an authority to edit the lifecycle
